Metadata.title: León Davis — Backend & Applied AI
Metadata.description: Portfolio of León Davis — Backend developer with Java/Spring Boot, microservices, cloud and applied AI (LLMs, computer vision).

Hero.tagline: Backend developer specializing in microservices, distributed architectures and applied artificial intelligence.
Hero.tagline2: I work with Java/Spring Boot, microservices, Kafka, Redis and LLMs.

About.label: About
About.title: Backend, data and AI.
About.p1: I hold a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science from the <bold>Universidad Nacional de San Agustín</bold> and I'm a backend developer with experience building microservices, distributed architectures and large-scale data pipelines.
About.p2: My current work focuses on <bold>Java and Spring Boot</bold> on hexagonal architecture, processing millions of records and hundreds of thousands of daily messages with Kafka, Redis and relational databases.
About.p3: In parallel I research and apply <bold>artificial intelligence</bold> — from LLMs for NL→SQL over open data, to distributed computer vision systems on GCP.

Contact.label: Contact
Contact.title: Let's talk.
Contact.subtitle: Available for opportunities in backend, cloud or applied research. Reach out and let's chat.

crimqa.title: CRIMQA
crimqa.summary: Natural-language question answering system over urban crime data, with interactive geographic visualizations generated from LLMs and official records.
highlights: Designed and implemented an NL→SQL pipeline over urban crime data.
Integrated LLMs with official records and social media publications.
Generated interactive geographic visualizations from natural language queries.
Paper accepted at IEEE SCCC 2025.

face-detection-fog-cloud.title: Face Detection Fog/Cloud
face-detection-fog-cloud.summary: Distributed face detection system on Fog/Cloud architecture deployed on Google Cloud Platform, with computer vision models served from edge to cloud.
highlights: Face detection with YOLOv8 and liveness verification with MiniFASNetV2.
Microservices orchestration on Cloud Run, Cloud Functions and Pub/Sub.
Infrastructure as code with Pulumi for reproducible environments.
Distributed processing between Fog and Cloud nodes for low latency.

clone-classroom.title: Google Classroom Clone
clone-classroom.summary: Functional replica of Google Classroom with Google OAuth authentication and Drive-backed file storage, on an MVC architecture in TypeScript.
highlights: Google sign-in with persistent session handling.
File storage on Google Drive for class materials.
Prisma ORM over MySQL for modelling and optimized queries.
MVC architecture separating frontend/backend responsibilities.

chat-real-time.title: Real-time Chat
chat-real-time.summary: Real-time messaging app with a typed MERN stack, containerized with Docker, reverse-proxied with Nginx and deployed on AWS EC2.
highlights: MERN stack + TypeScript for end-to-end typing.
Docker Compose for consistent dev and production environments.
Nginx as reverse proxy: caching, security and load balancing.
Deployment on AWS EC2 with high availability.

enrollment-management.title: Enrollment Management System
enrollment-management.summary: Course management microservice implemented with Domain-Driven Design in .NET, organized in layers (Application, Domain, Infrastructure, Web.API).
highlights: DDD layered architecture: Application, Domain, Infrastructure, Web.API.
CRUD operations, database integration and REST API exposure.
API testing with Postman and Swagger.
Performance testing with Apache JMeter and security with OWASP ZAP.

bullets: Built microservices with Java 8/11/25 and Spring Boot, applying hexagonal architecture and DDD for massive data migration processes and ETL pipelines over AS/400.
Modelled and tuned schemas in DB2 and SQL Server, with deployments and support on Linux environments via corporate SSH.
Implemented system integrations with Java 11 and JavaScript using IBM App Connect, SQL and ESQL for corporate clearing and settlement flows.
Designed corporate authentication mechanisms on IBM platforms for sensitive business processes.
Built microservices in Java 14 and Spring Boot, integrating Apache Kafka, ActiveMQ Artemis and JMS for high-volume asynchronous messaging.
Implemented Redis-based deduplication and resilience patterns (retry, DLQ) handling ~150k daily messages.

honors: Selected to attend CLEI 2024 (Bahía Blanca, Argentina).
Selected to attend SBSeg 2025 (Foz do Iguaçu, Brazil).
